meta.name: budgeting-and-forecasting
meta.description: Runs the planning cycle — annual budget, rolling forecast, consolidation of business unit inputs, and the variance analysis that explains actuals against plan. Use this to build or challenge a budget, run a forecast cycle, consolidate departmental submissions, explain why results diverged from plan, or improve forecast accuracy.

copy.tagline: 制定年度预算与滚动预测,并分析实际与计划的差异
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要编制年度预算或滚动预测,并想解释实际与计划的偏差。
copy.tagline_en: Build annual budgets and rolling forecasts, and analyze variances against plan.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create annual budgets or rolling forecasts and explain deviations from plan.

howto.what: 该技能会把预算和预测分开,并按一套流程来:先统一目标、假设和人数上限;用固定模板收各部门数据并核查;汇总后对比目标找缺口,点明削减项并公布未获批项及原因;滚动预测只改变化点;差异按量、单价、时间、构成拆解主要项。
howto.when: 当你要编制或质疑预算、跑滚动预测或做差异分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我做明年的年度预算,先统一目标和假设。
say.note: 会先定框架,再用模板收集部门数据。

say.text: 这轮滚动预测只更新变化的部分,其他照旧。
say.note: 会问哪些变了、为什么变,再更新。

say.text: 实际数和预算差了不少,帮我拆一下原因。
say.note: 会按量、单价、时间、构成拆解主要差异。

howto.what_en: Claude guides planning: aligns targets/assumptions/headcount; collects via a fixed template, challenges inputs; names cuts, lists what was not funded and why; updates forecasts only on change; splits variances by volume/rate/timing/mix.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to build or challenge a budget, run a rolling forecast, or do variance analysis.

say_en.text: Help me build next year's budget; set the targets and assumptions first.
say_en.note: It sets the frame first, then collects via the template.

say_en.text: For this rolling forecast, update only the parts that changed.
say_en.note: It asks what changed and why.

say_en.text: Actuals are off budget by a lot — can you break down why?
say_en.note: It splits major variances by volume, rate, timing, mix.
